items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, the rest of them Mack Walker, Bobby Bennett and Clyde Hart, wasn't it, or Sherman. [INTERVIEWER] James Sherman.

ctx.x: Yeah, 'You'se A Viper,' 'Here Comes the Man With the Jive,' things like that. You did those in 1936. And the only musician on there beside you and of course Stuff who really has any kind of a reputation was Jonah Jones.
Yeah, the rest of them Mack Walker, Bobby Bennett and Clyde Hart, wasn't it, or Sherman.
